name: pymeflow
description: PymeFlow — Plataforma SaaS de automatización tributaria y flujo de caja para microempresarios chilenos

scripts.db:migrate: cd apps/api && npx prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:push: cd apps/api && npx prisma db push
scripts.db:seed: cd apps/api && npx prisma db seed
scripts.docker:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d
